opening: In the year 1668, the world has never been more open. The Ottomans, the crowned heads of Europe, Qing China and the upstart empire of Mutapa vie with each other for dominance and victory in the great game of politics. A bloody war of resources in Sudamerica is about to explode across the continent, as the peoples of North America keep a wary eye on the European colonists that have established themselves on the East Coast.

The winds of change are blowing full-force. The old hierarchies of magic and faith have been challenged by natural philosophers and thinkers who don't bother with spells. The Wild Hunt of all peoples beats at the frontiers, raiding and stealing people for unknown purposes. Buried underneath the new neighborhoods of booming cities are old tombs, catacombs filled with threats and the promise of the lost treasures of a thousand ancient empires. Wealth beyond imagining could be yours, as could the ruin of nations.
world: Euphonia starts in Europe, but it doesn't end there. Western Europe is the default theme of most fantasy settings, but Euphonia is designed to be built out globally. Ships traverse every part of the ocean, magic can bridge continents and the world is far more interconnected than before. A dungeon delve can happen in a Mesopotamian ruin, beneath Great Zimbabwe, in the Haudenosaunee woods a French priest calls wilderness, at Angkor Wat and anywhere else in the world. History is rich with inspiration, usually far more interesting than one would even think to fictionalize. Finding adventure anywhere on the planet is the goal.
